scenario_space.name: o07-wind-terrain-friction-v1
scenario_space.notes: the declared scenario space of O-07; the sampled set is written to the output file so that every number below can be traced back to the scenarios that produced it

axes.name: wind_speed_m_s
axes.assumption: assumption: the reference walker's critical start wind is ~0.69 m/s (W-06, one model, E0); the range spans 'below the start threshold' to '2.8x the nominal breeze'. Not a measurement.

axes.name: wind_kind
axes.assumption: assumption: the three wind models registered in strandbeest_sim.winds (W-04). Which of them occurs on a given day is not known.

axes.name: gust_amplitude_m_s
axes.assumption: assumption: the gust peak deviation; the winds registry default is 1.0 m/s (not measured).

axes.name: gust_period_s
axes.assumption: assumption: the winds registry default is 6 s (not measured).

axes.name: turbulence_intensity
axes.assumption: assumption: the Dryden turbulence intensity I_u; the winds registry default is 0.15 (W-04).

axes.name: turbulence_seed
axes.assumption: assumption: which turbulence realisation is drawn; only the index is defined.

axes.name: yaw_deg
axes.assumption: assumption: the wind direction stays within 60 deg of the walking direction. A head wind is excluded on purpose: the wind model gives it no drive component at all, so it would be a trivial failure for every design and would hide the differences between them.

axes.name: terrain_kind
axes.assumption: assumption: the three terrain plans of strandbeest_sim.terrains that a walking beach can have.

axes.name: slope_deg
axes.assumption: assumption: an uphill slope of up to 8 deg; the terrain registry models it by tilting gravity.

axes.name: friction
axes.assumption: assumption: the ground friction coefficient; V-04 used 0.5 / 1.5 / 2.5.

axes.name: bump_count
axes.assumption: assumption: the number of random bumps of the 'bumps' terrain.

axes.name: bump_max_height_m
axes.assumption: assumption: the bump height; the terrain registry default is 0.015 m.

axes.name: bump_seed
axes.assumption: assumption: the placement seed of the bumps.

nominal.label: nominal: constant 5.0 m/s, flat ground, mu=1.5, yaw 0 deg

design_space.topology: Jansen (contracts/kinematics/jansen.json topology of the reference design)

assumptions.m: assumption: the crank length of the reference design is 15 units; the search range is a declared box around it, not an optimum found anywhere
assumptions.a: assumption: the hip offset of the reference design is 38 units; the search range is a declared box around it
assumptions.h: assumption: the thigh length of the reference design is 65.7 units; the search range is a declared box around it

design_space.note: a declared 3-parameter subspace around the reference design: with a few dozen physics evaluations a CMA-ES over all 13 linkage lengths would move nothing, so the subspace is stated instead of being hidden

physics.outcome: forward distance of the torso over the driving window (m, higher is better)

budget.note: the search is budget-limited; no convergence is claimed and the designs are not shown to be optimal

verdict.criterion: the robust design beats the nominal-optimal design in the worst scenario
verdict.note: level A is the strict reading (the worst scenario of the whole space, where the nominal-optimal design fails); level B is the hardest scenario the nominal-optimal design still walks in, which is where the designs can be told apart. Both are reported, whatever they say.
verdict.verdict: demonstrated in level A, level B
